title: Donald Trump: Written Off 3 Times, Back Every Time
thumbnail_picture: Big close shot on the right side: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) rising with his fist raised high among Secret Service agents, a small red mark on his ear, an American flag and bright blue sky behind, fierce determined face. The left third of the frame is plain dark shadow.
description:
Donald Trump was written off after his casinos went bankrupt, after losing in 2020, and after a criminal conviction. Then he returned to the White House. This is the full, neutral story of his rise, falls and comebacks.

From Queens and his father's building business to Trump Tower, The Art of the Deal, the Atlantic City bankruptcies, The Apprentice, the 2016 upset, two impeachments, January 6, four indictments, the Butler assassination attempt and the 2024 win.

Sources and further reading:
- Gwenda Blair, The Trumps: Three Generations That Built an Empire
- Michael D'Antonio, Never Enough: Donald Trump and the Pursuit of Success
- U.S. Senate records on the impeachment trials of 2020 and 2021 (senate.gov)
- National Archives, Electoral College results for 2016, 2020 and 2024

scenes.picture: A wide sunny farm field with a big outdoor rally stage, a huge crowd, red, white and blue banners, hot blue sky

scenes.narration: A gunshot. A crowded rally. A presidential candidate suddenly drops behind a podium.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) ducking down behind a podium on an outdoor stage as Secret Service agents in dark suits rush toward him, startled crowd behind

scenes.narration: Seconds later, Donald Trump rises, blood running down his face, and raises his fist toward the crowd.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) rising among agents in dark suits, a small red mark on his ear and cheek, fist raised high, an American flag and blue sky behind

scenes.narration: The photograph spreads across the world.
scenes.picture: Many glowing TV and phone screens in cities around the world, all showing the same small cartoon picture of a man raising his fist

scenes.narration: But here's what makes this moment extraordinary. This wasn't the first time Donald Trump's political career seemed finished.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) standing alone on a dark empty stage in a single spotlight, thoughtful

scenes.narration: He had faced billion-dollar business troubles. His casinos had collapsed.
scenes.picture: A dark, empty casino hall with rows of switched-off slot machines and dust in the air, gloomy light

scenes.narration: His television fame had once seemed like his biggest achievement.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) sitting at a TV studio boardroom table under bright lights, big cameras pointed at him

scenes.narration: He lost the 2020 election, faced two impeachments, and became the first former American president convicted of a felony.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) walking alone down a long dark marble courthouse hallway, aides far behind

scenes.narration: Yet, somehow, he was still standing.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) standing tall on a windy hilltop at dawn, coat blowing, determined face

scenes.narration: And just months after that terrifying day in Pennsylvania, he would return to the White House.
scenes.picture: The White House glowing at sunrise, a long black motorcade rolling through its gates

scenes.narration: So how did a boy from Queens become one of the most recognizable and controversial figures in American history?
scenes.picture: A small blond cartoon boy, young Donald Trump, standing on a quiet Queens sidewalk looking up at a distant Manhattan skyline

scenes.narration: This is the extraordinary journey of Donald Trump.
scenes.picture: The Manhattan skyline at golden hour seen from Queens, a long road leading toward it

scenes.narration: Donald John Trump was born on June 14, 1946, in Queens, New York.
scenes.picture: A quiet tree-lined Queens street of red-brick houses with 1940s cars, a mother pushing a baby carriage

scenes.narration: His father, Fred Trump, was a successful real estate developer who built thousands of homes and apartments for working families.
scenes.picture: A stern father, Fred Trump, in a 1950s suit and hat holding rolled blueprints in front of rows of new red-brick apartment buildings

scenes.narration: Donald grew up surrounded by construction sites, business discussions, and the world of real estate.
scenes.picture: A small blond cartoon boy, young Donald Trump, in a little hard hat standing beside his father on a busy building site with cranes and workers

scenes.narration: But he wasn't exactly an easy child to manage.
scenes.picture: A small blond cartoon boy, young Donald Trump, with a mischievous grin and crossed arms in a 1950s classroom while a teacher frowns

scenes.narration: At thirteen, after getting into trouble, his parents sent him to New York Military Academy.
scenes.picture: Thirteen-year-old Donald Trump, a blond cartoon boy in a gray cadet uniform, arriving with a suitcase at a grand stone military academy

scenes.narration: There, he learned discipline, played sports, and eventually became a cadet captain.
scenes.picture: Teenage Donald Trump, a blond cartoon cadet captain in a gray uniform, leading a line of marching cadets on a parade ground

scenes.narration: After attending Fordham University, he transferred to the prestigious Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania.
scenes.picture: Young Donald Trump in his twenties as a recognisable cartoon caricature (thick swept blond hair, broad face) in a 1960s jacket and tie carrying books across a red-brick university campus in autumn

scenes.narration: In 1968, he graduated and joined his father's real estate business.
scenes.picture: Young Donald Trump in his twenties as a recognisable cartoon caricature (thick swept blond hair, broad face) shaking hands with his stern father in a wood-paneled office, blueprints on the desk

scenes.narration: But Donald had a much bigger ambition. He didn't just want to build apartments in Queens.
scenes.picture: Young Donald Trump in his twenties as a recognisable cartoon caricature (thick swept blond hair, broad face) standing on a Queens rooftop looking past low brick buildings, restless

scenes.narration: He wanted Manhattan.
scenes.picture: Young Donald Trump in his twenties as a recognisable cartoon caricature (thick swept blond hair, broad face) on a Queens riverbank at dusk gazing across the water at the glittering Manhattan skyline

scenes.narration: In 1971, Trump took control of the family business and began looking beyond Brooklyn and Queens.
scenes.picture: Young Donald Trump in his twenties as a recognisable cartoon caricature (thick swept blond hair, broad face) in a 1970s suit behind a big desk with a model of skyscrapers on it, the Manhattan skyline through the window

scenes.narration: Manhattan was a completely different world. Big money. Luxury hotels. Famous addresses.
scenes.picture: Busy 1970s Fifth Avenue with grand hotels, yellow taxis and elegant crowds

scenes.narration: His opportunity came when he partnered with Hyatt to transform the struggling Commodore Hotel near Grand Central Terminal.
scenes.picture: A grimy, run-down old brick hotel beside the great stone Grand Central Terminal, young Donald Trump in his twenties as a recognisable cartoon caricature (thick swept blond hair, broad face) looking up at it

scenes.narration: With government tax incentives and a major renovation, the hotel reopened in 1980 as the Grand Hyatt.
scenes.picture: A gleaming hotel with a mirrored glass front reflecting the old stone train terminal beside it, golden afternoon light

scenes.narration: It was a major breakthrough. But Trump wanted something bigger.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) in a 1980s suit at a window high above Manhattan at night, city lights below

scenes.narration: In 1983, Trump Tower opened on Fifth Avenue.
scenes.picture: A tall black-glass skyscraper on Fifth Avenue seen from the street, crowds gathering at its entrance

scenes.narration: A 58-story skyscraper featuring luxury apartments, expensive shops, a dramatic marble atrium, and an indoor waterfall.
scenes.picture: Inside a lavish atrium with pink marble walls, brass railings, escalators and a tall indoor waterfall

scenes.narration: And above the entrance? His name. In giant golden letters.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) in a 1980s suit standing proudly with arms spread before a gleaming golden skyscraper entrance

scenes.narration: Trump had discovered something powerful: people weren't just buying buildings. They were buying the Trump brand.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) holding up a glowing golden key while a long line of eager buyers waits behind him

scenes.narration: During the 1980s, Trump's fame exploded.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) smiling in a sharp 1980s suit surrounded by photographers with big flashing cameras

scenes.narration: He appeared in magazines, became a regular topic in newspapers, and published The Art of the Deal in 1987 with journalist Tony Schwartz.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) signing copies of a blue hardcover book with a blank cover for a long line of fans in a bookstore

scenes.narration: The book became a bestseller. His business ambitions grew even bigger.
scenes.picture: A tall pyramid of identical blue books with blank covers in a busy bookstore window

scenes.narration: He bought the Plaza Hotel, entered the airline business, acquired casinos in Atlantic City, and pursued increasingly expensive projects.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) on the deck of a giant white luxury yacht, a passenger jet flying overhead and a casino tower on the shore

scenes.narration: One of his biggest ambitions was the Trump Taj Mahal casino.
scenes.picture: A giant casino resort with golden onion domes and minarets glowing at night beside the ocean

scenes.narration: It opened in 1990 after costing approximately a billion dollars. Trump appeared unstoppable.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) cutting a big red ribbon at a glittering casino entrance, fireworks above and a cheering crowd

scenes.narration: But there was a problem. Much of this empire was built on borrowed money.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) standing on top of a tall, wobbling tower of paper money and bank papers

scenes.narration: And when the economy slowed, the cracks began to appear.
scenes.picture: A close-up of a deep crack splitting across a shiny marble casino floor

scenes.narration: The 1990s brought a financial disaster.
scenes.picture: A nearly empty casino floor with rows of idle slot machines and a few bored gamblers, dim light

scenes.narration: His Atlantic City casinos struggled to generate enough money to cover their enormous debts.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) studying a long paper ledger at a desk piled high with bills, worried face

scenes.narration: In 1991, the Taj Mahal filed for bankruptcy. Other Trump businesses also went through bankruptcy restructurings.
scenes.picture: Stern bankers in gray suits around a long boardroom table facing a worried Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie)

scenes.narration: Banks negotiated with him, creditors took control of assets, and he gave up valuable holdings, including his yacht and airline.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) handing a ring of keys to a banker, a big white yacht sailing away through the window behind

scenes.narration: The newspapers that once celebrated his success now reported his financial troubles.
scenes.picture: A commuter on a rainy Manhattan street reading a folded newspaper with a worried face, umbrellas and yellow taxis behind

scenes.narration: The image of the unstoppable billionaire was falling apart. For many people, this was the end of the Trump empire.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) standing alone in the rain outside a dark tower, coat collar up

scenes.narration: But Trump had something that his creditors couldn't easily take away. His name.
scenes.picture: A close-up of a hand holding a glowing golden key in a dark room

scenes.narration: And he was about to turn that name into a business all over again.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) smiling slyly in a dim office as golden light breaks through the window

scenes.narration: Instead of personally building every property, Trump increasingly licensed his name to developers and businesses.
scenes.picture: Many shining hotel towers in different cities around the world, each topped with a glowing golden crown

scenes.narration: But his biggest comeback didn't happen in real estate. It happened on television.
scenes.picture: A big studio television camera turning toward the viewer under bright studio lights

scenes.narration: In 2004, NBC launched The Apprentice.
scenes.picture: A glossy TV studio set with a dark boardroom table under dramatic lights, cameras all around it

scenes.narration: The concept was simple. Contestants competed in business challenges, hoping to win a job in Trump's company.
scenes.picture: Young contestants in business suits racing down a city street carrying boxes and supplies

scenes.narration: And every episode ended with a now-famous phrase: You're fired!
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) at the boardroom table pointing his finger firmly at a nervous young contestant, dramatic light

scenes.narration: Millions of people watched. For years, Trump became a familiar face in American homes.
scenes.picture: Families in a farmhouse, a city apartment and a suburban home all watching glowing TVs at night

scenes.narration: He wasn't just a businessman anymore. He was a television celebrity.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) waving on a red carpet as cameras flash

scenes.narration: And television had given him something extremely valuable: national recognition. But what if he could turn that popularity into political power?
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) looking through a tall window at the white dome of the Capitol far in the distance

scenes.narration: Trump had considered running for president before. But on June 16, 2015, he finally made his announcement.
scenes.picture: A glittering marble atrium with a long golden escalator, reporters and cameras waiting below

scenes.narration: He descended the golden escalator at Trump Tower and declared that he was running for president.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) riding a golden escalator down and waving, a crowd with American flags below

scenes.narration: Many political experts underestimated him. He was competing against experienced politicians, governors, and senators.
scenes.picture: A long debate stage lined with serious politicians in dark suits, Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) in the middle under the spotlight

scenes.narration: But Trump understood something about television and public attention. He knew how to dominate a news cycle.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) on a giant screen in a busy TV newsroom, staff turning to watch

scenes.narration: His rallies attracted huge crowds. His statements generated headlines. His campaign became impossible to ignore.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) at a podium in a packed arena with arms raised, red, white and blue lights

scenes.narration: One by one, his Republican rivals dropped out. Then came the biggest test. Hillary Clinton.
scenes.picture: A debate stage with two podiums: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) facing Hillary Clinton as a recognisable cartoon caricature (blond bob, pantsuit)

scenes.narration: On November 8, 2016, Trump stunned political observers by winning the Electoral College.
scenes.picture: A TV newsroom at night, anchors and staff gaping in disbelief at a giant glowing screen

scenes.narration: Clinton received nearly 2.9 million more votes nationwide, but Trump won the presidency through the Electoral College, 304 to 227 in the final count.
scenes.picture: Election workers counting tall stacks of paper ballots in a big bright hall

scenes.narration: The businessman and reality television star was now the 45th president of the United States.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) in a dark overcoat raising his right hand on the steps of the white-domed Capitol, a huge crowd below

scenes.narration: Trump's first presidency was anything but quiet.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) at the desk in the Oval Office as aides rush in with papers

scenes.narration: He signed a major tax reform law, appointed three Supreme Court justices, and became the first sitting American president to meet North Korea's leader.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) shaking hands with Kim Jong Un, also a recognisable cartoon caricature, in front of a row of flags with no emblems

scenes.narration: But his presidency was also marked by intense political conflict.
scenes.picture: Two crowds holding blank signs facing each other across a street in front of the Capitol, tense

scenes.narration: In December 2019, the House of Representatives impeached him over his dealings with Ukraine. The Senate later acquitted him.
scenes.picture: The grand Senate chamber, senators at old wooden desks under a domed ceiling

scenes.narration: Then came 2020. The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted everyday life across America and around the world.
scenes.picture: An empty city street with closed shops and a lone person in a face mask

scenes.narration: His administration launched Operation Warp Speed, helping accelerate the development of COVID-19 vaccines.
scenes.picture: Scientists in a bright laboratory holding up glowing vaccine vials

scenes.narration: But the pandemic, economic disruption, and political divisions created enormous challenges. And then came the election that would change everything.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) at a White House window at night, looking out, worried

scenes.narration: November 2020. Trump lost the presidential election to Joe Biden. Biden won the Electoral College, 306 to 232.
scenes.picture: Joe Biden as a recognisable cartoon caricature (white hair, aviator sunglasses) waving on a stage as fireworks burst above a crowd

scenes.narration: Trump refused to accept the result and claimed the election had been stolen. Courts rejected dozens of lawsuits challenging the outcome.
scenes.picture: A stern judge at a tall wooden bench looking down at tall stacks of case files in a hushed courtroom

scenes.narration: Then, on January 6, 2021, a crowd of his supporters stormed the United States Capitol as Congress met to certify the election results.
scenes.picture: A large crowd surging up the steps of the white-domed Capitol under a gray winter sky

scenes.narration: The country watched in shock.
scenes.picture: A family in a living room staring at a TV in shock, hands over mouths

scenes.narration: The House impeached Trump for a second time. He was acquitted in the Senate, although a majority voted to convict.
scenes.picture: A tense Senate chamber, one senator standing at a wooden desk to vote

scenes.narration: He left the White House on January 20, 2021. For many observers, his political career appeared finished.
scenes.picture: A white and green presidential helicopter lifting off from the White House lawn on a gray morning

scenes.narration: But Trump wasn't finished.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) at a dark window of a Florida mansion, eyes narrowed, determined

scenes.narration: In November 2022, Trump announced that he would run for president again.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) at a podium in a glittering ballroom with flags and chandeliers

scenes.narration: But his campaign was about to face another extraordinary challenge.
scenes.picture: Dark storm clouds gathering over a tall stone courthouse with columns

scenes.narration: In 2023, he was indicted in four separate criminal cases involving New York, Florida, Washington, and Georgia. He pleaded not guilty.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) walking up wide courthouse steps between stone columns, reporters with cameras behind

scenes.narration: Then, on May 30, 2024, a Manhattan jury found him guilty on 34 counts of falsifying business records.
scenes.picture: A wood-paneled New York courtroom, a jury of twelve ordinary people in two rows, a judge's bench above

scenes.narration: He became the first former American president convicted of a crime.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) walking down a courthouse hallway with a stony expression

scenes.narration: Many believed the legal battles could destroy his chances of returning to power. Instead, his campaign continued.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) stepping off a campaign plane and waving to a crowd on the tarmac

scenes.narration: And then came July 13, 2024.
scenes.picture: A calm sunny farm field with an outdoor stage and flags, crowds arriving, an eerie quiet

scenes.narration: Butler, Pennsylvania. Trump was speaking at an outdoor campaign rally when gunshots suddenly rang out.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) speaking at a podium on an outdoor stage, the crowd behind him, sunny sky

scenes.narration: He was struck in the ear and rushed to the ground by Secret Service agents.
scenes.picture: Secret Service agents in dark suits covering Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) behind the podium

scenes.narration: A spectator, Corey Comperatore, was killed. Two others were seriously wounded.
scenes.picture: An empty row of folding chairs on the grass with a single cap left on one, somber light

scenes.narration: Then came a moment that would become one of the defining images of the campaign. Trump stood up.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) rising up among agents in dark suits, an American flag behind

scenes.narration: Blood covered his face. He raised his fist and shouted toward the crowd.
scenes.picture: Close-up of Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) with a red mark on his cheek raising his fist, agents around him, blue sky

scenes.narration: The photograph travelled around the world.
scenes.picture: TV screens in cities around the world, all showing a tiny cartoon of a raised fist

scenes.narration: Just days later, he formally accepted the Republican presidential nomination.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) with a white bandage on his ear on a convention stage, balloons and a cheering crowd

scenes.narration: The election was approaching. And the man many had counted out was now fighting for the White House again.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) at a night rally with arms raised before a sea of flags

scenes.narration: On November 5, 2024, Donald Trump defeated Kamala Harris.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) celebrating on stage at night with arms wide as confetti falls

scenes.narration: He won all seven major swing states and secured 312 Electoral College votes to Harris's 226. He also won the national popular vote.
scenes.picture: A cheering crowd in a big hall with red, white and blue balloons

scenes.narration: On January 20, 2025, Trump took the presidential oath inside the Capitol Rotunda.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) raising his right hand under the golden dome of the Capitol Rotunda, solemn

scenes.narration: He became the second American president in history, after Grover Cleveland, to serve two non-consecutive terms.
scenes.picture: A cartoon Grover Cleveland (big mustache, 1890s suit) and Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) standing side by side in a grand hall

scenes.narration: The boy from Queens had returned to the most powerful office in America.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) walking toward the White House at sunrise

scenes.narration: Think about the journey. A young man who entered his father's real estate business.
scenes.picture: Young Donald Trump in his twenties as a recognisable cartoon caricature (thick swept blond hair, broad face) and his father walking through a Queens building site

scenes.narration: A businessman who built skyscrapers and casinos.
scenes.picture: A black-glass skyscraper and a domed casino resort side by side at sunset

scenes.narration: An entrepreneur whose companies went through bankruptcy.
scenes.picture: A dark casino at night with its lights switched off

scenes.narration: A television personality who became a household name.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) in a TV boardroom pointing at the camera

scenes.narration: A presidential candidate who shocked the political establishment.
scenes.picture: A TV newsroom on election night, staff staring at a giant screen in shock

scenes.narration: A president who lost an election, faced impeachment twice, and fought multiple criminal cases.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) walking down a long courthouse hallway

scenes.narration: And finally, a man who returned to the White House after one of the most extraordinary political comebacks in American history.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) under the golden dome of the Capitol Rotunda, hand raised

scenes.narration: You can agree with him or disagree with him. But one thing is undeniable.
scenes.picture: The silhouette of Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) against a bright, cloudy sky

scenes.narration: Donald Trump's journey has been filled with extraordinary highs, devastating lows, and unexpected returns.
scenes.picture: A winding road over mountains and deep valleys leading to the White House in the distance

scenes.narration: And his story proves that in politics, sometimes the most unexpected chapter comes after everyone thinks the story is over.
scenes.picture: An old leather book lying open, warm golden light spilling up from its last pages

scenes.narration: What do you think: was Donald Trump's return the greatest political comeback in modern American history? Let us know in the comments.
scenes.picture: The silhouette of Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) at a White House window at dusk

narrator: Epic historical narrator, deep and confident, dramatic swells, quick through action, slower only for the final line.

short.title: The Man Who Kept Coming Back
short.description: Bankrupt casinos, a lost election, a criminal conviction, and still back in the White House. Donald Trump's comeback story in under a minute.

scenes.narration: Imagine nearly losing your business empire, becoming a TV celebrity, losing the presidency, facing a criminal conviction, and still making it back to the White House.
scenes.picture: Close-up of Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie), half his face in shadow and half in golden light, the White House glowing behind him at night

scenes.narration: That's Donald Trump's story.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) turning to look straight at the viewer, confident smile

scenes.narration: Born in Queens in 1946, he entered his father's real estate business and built famous properties like Trump Tower.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) in a 1980s suit standing proudly with arms spread before a tall black-glass skyscraper on Fifth Avenue

scenes.narration: But his empire nearly collapsed.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) standing on a cracking marble floor as a casino tower tilts behind him

scenes.narration: His Atlantic City casinos went bankrupt, and his business reputation took a massive hit.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) sitting alone on an empty casino floor among switched-off slot machines, worried face

scenes.narration: Then came The Apprentice.
scenes.picture: A glossy TV studio boardroom under bright lights, cameras turning on

scenes.narration: Millions watched him on television, and in 2016, he shocked the world by becoming America's 45th president.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) in a dark overcoat raising his right hand on the Capitol steps, huge crowd below

scenes.narration: But in 2020, he lost the election.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) walking away alone across a gray White House lawn toward a waiting helicopter

scenes.narration: He faced a second impeachment and multiple criminal cases.
scenes.picture: Donald Trump as a clearly recognisable cartoon caricature (swept blond hair, broad face, dark suit, long red tie) walking up wide courthouse steps between columns, reporters behind

scenes.narration: In May 2024, a jury convicted him on 34 counts.
